resources.string: Audio behavior logging runs with the CarPlay host: play/pause commands, reported playback, focus and buffer events. Reproduce the issue, then export this report. No sound is recorded; OEM-private Bluetooth events may not be visible.
Insert a USB drive, then choose its mounted path. Storage permissions are checked when saving.

Targets Android settings components directly instead of the car settings resolver. Try Wi-Fi or Apps if the main page is customized. Missing, protected, or OEM-redirected pages cannot be unlocked by this shortcut.
